title: New York marks 25th anniversary of World Trade Center attacks
subhed: Civilians joined bereaved family members and political figures in New York on Friday for 25th-anniversary commemorations of the September 11, 2001 attacks on the World Trade Center. Designed to be apolitical, the ceremonies did not escape controversy due to the absence of President Donald Trump.

25 years after 9/11, counterterrorism measures continue to undermine rule of law
subhed: Since 2001, Western countries, led by the United States, have steadily strengthened their counterterrorism powers through criminal and legal measures, prison regimes and mass surveillance tools. These measures have come at the cost of a steady erosion of fundamental rights.

title: What is BAPS, the Indian organization whose Eiffel Tower visit caused a strike?
subhed: Female employees of the Paris landmark were allegedly sidelined at the request of the conservative religious group, leading to a strike and temporary closure. The Hindu organization has recently inaugurated a temple in France.

title: Céline Dion's Paris residency brings economic boost: 'When you're a fan, money is no object'
subhed: After six years away from the stage, the Québécois superstar begins a run of 26 concerts in Paris on Saturday. Hoteliers, restaurateurs and retailers hope to benefit from the influx of nearly 800,000 fans, both French and international. The windfall is estimated at between €500 million and €1 billion, but it comes at a climate cost.
